section: AP Socio-Economic Survey - key indicators of the latest edition

accepted.s: The latest edition of the Socio-Economic Survey of Andhra Pradesh referred to for the headline growth indicators is
accepted.x: The latest edition is the Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26. Its growth figures are First Advance Estimates (FAE).
accepted.tq: Use the exact edition and estimate stage rather than a nearby year.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly compares Andhra Pradesh's broad-sector growth rates with the corresponding all-India rates in 2025-26 FAE?
o: Agriculture and allied: 9.15% and 6.2%; Industry: 10.14% and 3.1%; Services: 10.67% and 9.1%
Agriculture and allied: 10.14% and 3.1%; Industry: 9.15% and 6.2%; Services: 10.67% and 9.1%
Agriculture and allied: 3.1% and 10.14%; Industry: 6.2% and 9.15%; Services: 9.1% and 10.67%
Agriculture and allied: 10.70% and 3.1%; Industry: 6.58% and 6.2%; Services: 8.53% and 9.1%
accepted.x: The reported AP and India growth rates are 10.14% and 3.1% for agriculture and allied, 9.15% and 6.2% for industry, and 10.67% and 9.1% for services.
accepted.tq: Match each broad sector with its own AP and India rate.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which broad sector recorded the highest growth in Andhra Pradesh in the 2025-26 First Advance Estimates?
accepted.x: Services grew by 10.67%, higher than agriculture and allied at 10.14% and industry at 9.15%, making it the fastest broad sector.
accepted.tq: Compare the three broad-sector rates before selecting the highest.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The final revised estimate for Andhra Pradesh's 2024-25 GSDP was
o: Rs 15.91 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.67 lakh crore at constant prices
Rs 16.06 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.73 lakh crore at constant prices
Rs 15.91 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.73 lakh crore at constant prices
Rs 17.62 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 9.52 lakh crore at constant prices
accepted.x: The 2024-25 FRE is Rs 15.91 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.67 lakh crore at constant prices.
accepted.tq: Distinguish revised estimates from the earlier advance estimates.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the growth rates associated with the 2024-25 Final Revised Estimates of Andhra Pradesh?
o: 12.94% at current prices and 9.24% at constant prices
11.75% at constant prices and 8.27% at current prices
10.75% at current prices and 9.88% at constant prices
11.75% at current prices and 8.27% at constant prices
accepted.x: The 2024-25 FRE growth rates were 11.75% at current prices and 8.27% at constant prices.
accepted.tq: Check both the estimate stage and the price basis before comparing percentages.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding selected 2025-26 sub-sector shares of GVA at current prices.
List-I (Sub-sector)

B. Other Services
C. Horticulture
D. Real Estate
List-II (Share)

2. 8.81%

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched for sub-sector growth at constant prices in 2025-26?
accepted.x: Electricity, Gas and Water recorded 5.39%, not 5.93%. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the single altered digit in an otherwise familiar numerical pair.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Services-sector growth in Andhra Pradesh at constant prices in 2025-26:
1. Communications recorded the highest growth at 15.13%.
2. Banking recorded 13.59% growth.
3. Public Administration recorded the lowest growth at 0.05%.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Communications grew by 15.13%, Banking by 13.59%, and Public Administration had the lowest growth at 0.05%.
accepted.tq: Verify the highest, an intermediate value and the lowest value separately.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match the following 2024-25 current-price GVA sub-sector shares with the correct percentages.
A. Construction, Real Estate and Other Services
B. Trade
C. Banking
D. Public Administration
1. 8%
2. 7%
3. 5%

Choose the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Construction, Real Estate and Other Services each had 8%; Trade had 7%; Banking 5%; and Public Administration 4%.
accepted.tq: Group the equal-share sectors first, then match the descending percentages.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with its 2024-25 current-price GVA share in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Communications accounted for 2%. Mining also had 2%, while Railways had 1% and Agriculture 4%.
accepted.tq: Check the small percentage entries individually instead of relying on broad-sector intuition.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which sub-sector recorded the highest growth among the service sub-sectors in the Survey overview for 2024-25 at constant prices?
accepted.x: Communications recorded 15.28%, followed by Banking and Insurance at 14.61% in the Survey overview.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the highest service growth from the separate lowest-growth figure.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the 2024-25 constant-price growth rates of the broad sectors in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: In 2024-25 at constant prices, agriculture grew by 10.70%, industry by 6.58% and services by 8.53%.
accepted.tq: Keep the three broad sectors in their stated order.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As per the 2024-25 Survey figures, which broad sector had the largest current-price GVA and what was its value?
accepted.x: Services was the largest broad sector at current prices, with GVA of Rs 6.11 lakh crore and growth of 11.70%.
accepted.tq: Do not confuse the current-price value with the constant-price value.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly matches an inflation measure with the April–October 2025 figures for Andhra Pradesh and India?
accepted.x: CPI-IW inflation was 1.86% in Andhra Pradesh against 2.82% in India. CPI-AL was 0.81% against 1.78%.
accepted.tq: Separate the CPI-IW and CPI-AL labels before comparing their values.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding inflation in Andhra Pradesh during April–October 2025:
1. CPI-AL inflation in Andhra Pradesh was lower than in India.
2. Andhra Pradesh's combined CPI index level was 200.6.
3. India's combined CPI index level was 195.9.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: CPI-AL was 0.81% in AP against 1.78% in India, while the combined CPI index levels were 200.6 for AP and 195.9 for India.
accepted.tq: Notice that a lower inflation rate can coexist with a higher index level.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: For 2023-24 PLFS data covering all ages, which one of the following correctly states the LFPR, WPR and unemployment rate of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: For all ages in 2023-24, LFPR was 47.5%, WPR 45.6% and unemployment 4.1%.
accepted.tq: Read the age group first and distinguish LFPR from WPR.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following unemployment figures for Andhra Pradesh in 2023-24 is correctly matched with the population group?
accepted.x: The reported unemployment rates were rural 3.4%, urban 5.9%, youth 17.5% and female 6.9%.
accepted.tq: Use the population labels to detect swapped subgroup figures.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly relates the age group to the 2023-24 employment indicators reported in the SDG table?
accepted.x: For ages 15–59, unemployment was 4.4% and LFPR was 67.3%; these differ from the all-age figures.
accepted.tq: Treat the age group as part of the statistic, not as a detachable qualifier.
accepted.sec: Headline indicators - GSDP growth, sector and sub-sector GVA shares, inflation, employment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the Survey data for 2025-26, Andhra Pradesh held the first rank in which of the following?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in fruit production, accounting for 15.6% of India's production. It ranked seventh in milk, second in raw silk and sixth in exports.
accepted.tq: Separate first-rank achievements from other high national ranks.
accepted.sec: State awards and national ranks reported in the Survey  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's production rankings:
1. Andhra Pradesh ranked first in egg production, with 2,739 crore eggs.
2. It ranked fourth in meat production, with 11.37 lakh MT.
3. It ranked seventh in milk production, with 139.46 lakh MT.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: AP ranked first in eggs, fourth in meat and seventh in milk, with the stated quantities.
accepted.tq: Combine rank and quantity so that both parts of each claim are checked.
accepted.sec: State awards and national ranks reported in the Survey  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with Andhra Pradesh's position reported in the Survey?
o: Fish production — leading state, about 29% of India's production
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh was described as the leading state in fish production, contributing about 29% of India's fish production. It ranked second in raw silk, first in micro-irrigation and sixth in exports.
accepted.tq: Reject swapped ranks by comparing each item with its reported position.
accepted.sec: State awards and national ranks reported in the Survey  [APPSC]

accepted.s: With reference to micro-irrigation implementation in 2024-25, which statement is correct?
o: Andhra Pradesh ranked first, and six of its districts were in the national top ten.
Andhra Pradesh ranked first, and ten of its districts were in the national top twelve.
Andhra Pradesh ranked second, and six of its districts were in the national top ten.
Andhra Pradesh ranked third, and four of its districts were in the national top ten.
accepted.x: AP ranked first in micro-irrigation implementation in 2024-25, with six districts in the national top ten.
accepted.tq: Check both the state rank and the district count.
accepted.sec: State awards and national ranks reported in the Survey  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh's position in MGNREGS employment in 2025-26, along with the person-days generated, was
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked third in MGNREGS employment, generating 1,635 lakh person-days in 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Match the rank with the correct scale of employment generation.
accepted.sec: State awards and national ranks reported in the Survey  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Andhra Pradesh's export position reported in the Survey?
o: Sixth largest exporting state, exporting 824 commodities to 194 countries
Fourth largest exporting state, exporting 194 commodities to 824 countries
Sixth largest exporting state, exporting 194 commodities to 824 countries
Seventh largest exporting state, exporting 824 commodities to 194 countries
accepted.x: AP was the sixth largest exporting state, with 824 commodities exported to 194 countries.
accepted.tq: Keep the commodity count, country count and rank in their correct order.
accepted.sec: State awards and national ranks reported in the Survey  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements is correct regarding the awards and recognitions reported for Andhra Pradesh?
o: Andhra Pradesh received no national recognition under iGOT Karmayogi.
Andhra Pradesh was declared the lowest-performing state under iGOT Karmayogi.
Andhra Pradesh was ranked sixth under iGOT Karmayogi.
Andhra Pradesh was recognised as a top-performing state under iGOT Karmayogi.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh was reported as a top-performing state under iGOT Karmayogi.
accepted.tq: Use the exact performance description instead of converting it into a numerical rank.

accepted.s: Under ODOP-2024, which combination correctly represents Andhra Pradesh's achievement?
o: Two State Awards and 10 of 12 District Awards
State Award and 10 of 12 District Awards
State Award and 12 of 12 District Awards
No State Award and 10 of 12 District Awards
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh won the ODOP-2024 State Award and 10 of the 12 District Awards.

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT among the products receiving ODOP-2024 Gold Awards in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The Gold Awards went to Chirala silk, Guntur chillies, Venkatagiri sarees and Bobbili Veena. Mangalagiri cotton was not listed among them.
accepted.tq: Find the outsider in a list of locally associated products.

accepted.s: Which Andhra Pradesh tourist site holds Blue Flag certification?
accepted.x: Rushikonda beach holds the Blue Flag certification.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact certified location rather than a familiar tourism site.

accepted.s: According to the CDCA data for the second quarter of 2025-26, which sector recorded the highest real growth in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: CDCA reported real GSDP growth of 9.9%; agriculture led at 13.5%, followed by industry at 10.6% and services at 9.9%.
accepted.tq: Compare sectoral rates within the same data release and avoid mixing them with Survey FAE rates.
